name: 22-ky-network-error-patterns
title: Use regexes for Safari and Chrome network error messages
body: Replace the startsWith/endsWith checks for the "Load failed (host)" and "Failed to fetch (host)" message variants with two small regexes.

bugs.why: The Chrome pattern lacks a trailing $ anchor, so any TypeError starting with "Failed to fetch" (e.g. "Failed to fetch dynamically imported module") is treated as a network error and retried.
